context.bars_note: Only 512 (0.60 A) and 298 (0.35 A) have bars of record. No transform changes in this row and no accuracy claim is owed beyond same-seed repeatability, so the 512 bar is carried unchanged to 384, 640 and 768 as a deliberately conservative convention: larger targets have larger seed floors, so 0.60 A is a tighter test there than at 512, not a looser one.
context.same_seed_only: A/A across clock arms and repetitions. No transform changed, so no new float64 model reference is needed. A clock change or a repetition must not move the structure; if it does, that is a finding and a STOP.
context.hard_stop: a non-finite coordinate or a non-finite pLDDT at any size is a hard stop, not a rejection

aa_floor.note: the A/A floor is what an identical arm repeated costs. A leg whose work signal is inside the floor-implied uncertainty of its two sizes cannot support an exponent claim.
